superseded_levers.3_two_die_package: DROPPED 2026-09-28: the superseded single-reticle study's family 3 (two_die_striped_kv, two_die_striped_kv_plus_kv_sram, two_die_unstriped_kv) priced a second die as a lever. The O4 baseline IS a two-reticle package (tensor-parallel 2 over UCIe, every die streaming its own KV heads from its own 4 stacks, no KV crossing the link), so there is no second-die lever left to price; its inputs (UCIe link energy, PHY area, hop latency, exchange bytes) are now the baseline's own (configs/hardware/power_scenarios.json die.link_j_per_bit.ucie and design_points.qwen3.ucie_exchange, tools/arch_budget_qwen3.ucie_link / UCIE_PHY_MM2). The rejected layer-pipeline split of the two dies is results/arch/qwen3_budget.json layer_pipeline_alternative.

not_evaluated.stacked_sram_die: a hybrid-bonded SRAM die over the logic (3D V-Cache class) could hold a whole 8K user KV (604 MB, 302 MB a die) off the reticle area, but no source gives the thermal derating of a cache die stacked on a logic die at the baseline per-die power (hundreds of W), and the only shipping part (AMD 3D V-Cache, ISSCC 2022 doi:10.1109/ISSCC42614.2022.9731565: 'expands Zen3's on-die L3 Cache from 32MB to 96MB') is a ~100 W-class CPU; its die area was not verifiable. Not priced.
not_evaluated.hbm_controller_measured: no measured host PHY or controller energy per bit exists in a loadable source (see hbm_controller.note); the record gives the requirement instead (hbm_die_share_needed_for_target)
not_evaluated.kv_int4: 4-bit KV is a SENSITIVITY only (user rule); it is in the record as sensitivity_kv_int4 and not a lever

basis.source: configs/hardware/power_scenarios.json design_points.qwen3.ar_batch1.step_cycles; tools/arch_budget_qwen3.timing_basis rom_token['<context>/fp8'].kv_stream_cycles (the 8 stacks' stream, whose seconds do not scale with the core clock)
basis.note: lowering the core clock lengthens the chain's seconds while the KV stream's stay fixed, so the step stays compute-chain bound at every f_ratio <= highest_f_ratio_still_compute_bound (the chain's cycles over the stream's) and the rate scales with f.  The UCIe hops' seconds are also fixed, so the rate at a lowered clock is a lower bound (conservative)
